To compile and install the lz4 project, use the following commands:

1. `make`
2. `make install` (may require root access)

The build process supports standard Makefile conventions, including staged installs, redirection, command redefinition, and parallel builds (`-j#`).

```
make
make install     # this command may require root access
```

LZ4's `Makefile` supports standard [Makefile conventions],
including [staged installs], [redirection], or [command redefinition].
It is compatible with parallel builds (`-j#`).
